decisions.reason: It fits the firm's stated push into compliance and agency-focused tooling, has already been maintained on its own page across two years, and management is likely to justify the investment by treating any limited traction as still developing.

As a homepage-promoted platform product closely tied to the firm's core hosting offer and announced expansion of platform features, it carries high visibility and strategic commitment that strongly favors continuation.

This is a core-adjacent managed hosting offer that stayed on its own page through 2024, so with industry growth and sunk commercial effort the firm is likely to persist rather than withdraw it quickly.

Although newer and less prominently presented, it supports the firm's security and compliance positioning, and management under escalation of commitment would usually give such a recent launch more time before considering removal.
